subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “Coach Lin carried a small notebook during basketball practice.”?
options: He thought it was not important.
Many students thought it would be easy.
Players thought it contained secret plans.
Mia thought her brother ate it.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「He thought it was not important.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Many students thought it would be easy.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Players thought it contained secret plans.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Mia thought her brother ate it.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Players thought it contained secret plans.」，答案為「Players thought it contained secret plans.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Players thought it contained secret plans.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
